Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required points: 4 years of data science experience, hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (Pyro, PyMC3, JAGS, or similar), experience with Amazon SageMaker, and experience with PySpark.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
